question: Select the correct meaning of the idiom “Lose one’s temper.”
solution: The correct answer is: **Option 1** i.e., **To become suddenly angry**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The idiom **"Lose one's temper"** means to become suddenly angry or lose control of one’s emotions. (गुस्सा हो जाना) • **Example:** She lost her temper when her younger brother broke her favorite vase. • **To become suddenly angry** refers to a situation where someone gets irritated or furious quickly. (गुस्से में आना) • **Example:** The teacher lost his temper when the students continued to talk loudly despite several warnings. Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 1**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences: • **Option 2: To remain patient** (धैर्य रखना): To stay calm and composed in a difficult or irritating situation. • **Example:** Even after waiting for two hours, he remained patient and did not complain. • **Option 3: To escape quietly** (चुपचाप भाग जाना): To leave a place secretly without drawing attention. • **Example:** The thief escaped quietly before anyone could notice him. • **Option 4: To react politely** (शिष्टता से प्रतिक्रिया देना): To respond in a respectful and polite manner. • **Example:** Despite the rude comment, she reacted politely and maintained her dignity. 35:Ta1a, The correct answer is: **Unclear**.
